title: Agent Tool Manifest V1
description: The safe manifest a registered tool exposes to a model prompt or a user-visible surface. Constitution 1.1.0 restricts this to name, type, responsibility, required permission and availability: endpoints, credentials, tokens and connection strings MUST NOT appear here, and a tool absent from this manifest MUST NOT be described as callable nor have its result simulated.

type.description: A write tool may only execute through a run whose allow_write is true and whose pending write has been approved.

unavailable_reason.description: Required in practice when available is false, so a capability gap is reported explicitly instead of the tool silently disappearing.

source.description: MCP tools are permitted under constitution 1.1.0 but route through the same typed registry as internal ones.
